Intro: Welcome, Ronan, to Waesfjord — our home on the rugged coast of Éire. A place forged by wind, sea, and old Norse steel.
Lately... strange things have begun to appear. Ghostly figures, future echoes... some say they're just tales, others say they're warnings.
As our clan grew in number, we built new outposts across Éire. The land welcomed us, but something felt... wrong.
Modern buildings... made of glass and steel... rising from the ground where our forests once stood. Time is breaking, Ronan.
Pollution — black tar, plastic relics, rubber waste — poisons our sacred sites. Our watchtowers and shrines no longer whisper back to us.
We built a bridge to the great forest across the ravine... but Wessex soldiers were already there, waiting. They knew our every move.

Our waypoints and villages are under attack. Spirits twist the truth, buildings rise from lost futures, and our world fades. Ronan, we need your strength — push them back to England and save our land!
Back to the village. The fight is not over. The land remembers, and so must we.
